youtube.title: Why Ice Cubes Turn Cloudy 🧊 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Ice cubes turn cloudy because water holds dissolved air, and ice crystals cannot hold it. A home freezer freezes water from the outside in, so the air gets pushed toward the middle and trapped as tiny bubbles. Those bubbles scatter light and make the ice look white. On a still lake, ice freezes slowly from the top down, so air escapes and the ice can stay clear.
